cardOverview.overviewText: A Duo card combining credit and debit features, offering convenience with rewards on everyday shopping and digital payments.

items.child: Get an insurance benefit of Rs 25 lakh.

benefitRows.name: Air Accident Insurance
benefitRows.description: Get an insurance benefit of Rs 25 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, email rupay@newindia.co.in within 30 days of the incident. Ensure to submit all required documents within 60 days of reporting the claim

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: You can earn free movie tickets worth Rs 3,000 every year via this card.|Additionally, you can also avail of the Buy One and Get One Free Movie Ticket offers on your bookings via BookMyShow.|However, this offer can be availed once per month, i.e., up to 12 times a year, and the price of the free ticket is capped at Rs 250.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
